steps.note: S1.1.1.1.1 gives the subtraction of Ja+Rc, the addition of R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx), the restoring of a,c, and the net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, quoting line 748.

S1.1.1.1.2 states the central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, that the side wires cancel exactly the intersection-one pairs, that intersections zero and two already give 0, and that the self coefficient is 3=1.
The plan treats only the bit case; the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 and the side wires cancelling intersections zero and two appear nowhere.
S1.1.1.1.3 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), with each invocation restoring its own auxiliary wires.
The plan says every edge joins comparable labels (S1.1.1.3.4) but never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions; only the side edge 2->5 and the central loss h are touched.
S1.1.1.3.3 gives the inclusion of the 2->5 labels because t_X is orthogonal to t_Y, but omits the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp and its dimension h-2, which is the rest of the sub-step's content.
S1.1.1.3.4 gives the center 3->4 edge as the only decrease, of loss h with L=Ich, and S1.1.1.3.5 gives the telescoping to sinks Wm-N minus sources N, adding 2L for absolute changes to get Wm-2N+2L.

S2.1.1.1 states that each nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate and contains a norm-one vector, so it is nonalternating and has an orthonormal basis by splitting off unit lines and absorbing alternating planes.
S2.1.1.2 states that orthogonal binary vectors have even support intersection, so weight is additive mod 4 and q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal residual basis.

S2.1.1.3 gives odd weight, the phase i^{+-[v.x]} split as (1+i^{+-1})/2+(1-i^{+-1})/2(-1)^{v.x}, and conjugation by H^{tensor m} into aI+bX_v or its inverse, a faithful paraphrase of the H diag(1,-1) H = X step.
The plan counts s_c kernels (S2.1.1.4) but never states that on k columns each residual vector gives one tensored factor K_{e,v}^{tensor k}, which is the sub-step's content.

S2.1.1.5 gives frame I at zero labels and C^{tensor m} at full labels, C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates of u_a on X_a->Y_a, repaired by Z corrections before and after with scalar i^{27k}, and S2.1.2.2 adds undoing the signed bank exchange (the X-output negation).
S1.1.1.4.3 derives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, short of W_b m by N-2L_b>0 because L_b/N<1/2, and S2.1.1.4 gives the complex deficit 2N-2L_c>0.
The complex relative deficit eta_c=73/19906842167500 is never stated; the plan only asserts s/W<=m^sigma for the complex recursion (S2.4, S2.4.5).

S1.1.4.3 gives the chain m^{1-2^-50}=m exp(-2^-50 log m)>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta)=s/W from deficit > 20*2^-50 and log m<20, quoting line 1331 on both deficits, with tau=1-2^-50 (S1.1.4) and tau=sigma (S5.1.1).
S1.1.2.1 gives the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost nonzero entry, clearing by lower-triangular row and column operations, and one rank-one block per pivot, so Pi has exactly a ones.
S1.1.2.2 chooses a fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator and diagonal numerator in the finite table, so the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
S1.1.2.3 states that a lower-triangular change costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order from still-original earlier coordinates.
S1.1.2.4 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, then D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, and S1.1.2.5 gives exactly a interchanges in all.
S2.5.1 defines E=64(W+m+1)^3 and B=s+E and S2.5 gives Delta=ceil(C_0 d^20), but C_0=128mB^2, nu=min{j: m^j>=B}, C_1=max{20,nu+3} and nu=11 are never given, so C_0 and nu are named without content.
S2.5.1 states that a chain gains at most E per network invocation and at most 8e at a leaf, giving A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E.
S2.5.1 unrolls to arithmetic depth at most 8dB^{k+1}<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} (equivalent to B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu), and at most C_0 d^20 after the outer phases and scale.

S2.5.2 gives depth-j values in 2^{-(p+j)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^j, so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact, and S2.5.3 gives Delta=o(p) from 20 epsilon<1 (epsilon C_1<1 with C_1=20).
S2.5.4 states absolute row sum one for every row, so disks are preserved, and truncation toward zero errs by less than sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: P01 states 20 of the 26 sub-steps. It is thorough on the bank exchange (bit case), the matrix shear, the phase kernels and the guard-width chain. It omits the complex-case exchange coefficients (B3), the per-edge residual table (L1), the h-2 complement on the side edge (L2), the k-column tensoring of kernels (P3), eta_c (R3), and the definitions of C_0, nu and C_1 (S1). Nothing is stated contrary to the paper.
